Package com.codedstream.otterstream.rules.connector

Class RestDecisionEngineConnector

java.lang.Object
com.codedstream.otterstream.rules.connector.RestDecisionEngineConnector
All Implemented Interfaces:
DecisionEngineConnector
public final class RestDecisionEngineConnector extends Object implements DecisionEngineConnector
A configurable DecisionEngineConnector that talks to any external decision engine exposing a REST endpoint — Red Hat Decision Manager / KIE Server, Camunda DMN, IBM ODM Decision Server, or an in-house decision service. See DecisionEngineConnector's Javadoc for why this is one configurable connector rather than one class per vendor.

Uses the JDK's built-in HttpClient (stable since Java 11) rather than a bundled HTTP library — deliberately zero new runtime dependencies for this connector, consistent with otter-stream-rules's minimal-footprint design; JSON (de)serialization reuses jackson-databind, already a transitive dependency via ml-inference-core, not a new one this module introduces.

Request/response mapping

The request body sent is: 

 {
   "modelId": "...",
   "outputs": { ...InferenceResult.getOutputs()... },
   "context": { ...caller-supplied context... }
 }
The response is expected to be a JSON object with at least a flag field; category, confidence, and matchedRuleIds are read if present. Engines with a different native response shape (e.g. raw KIE Server XML/JSON envelopes) should front this connector with a small adapter/gateway that normalizes to the shape above — kept deliberately out of this connector so it doesn't accumulate vendor-specific response parsing.

0.1.0
